doctrine.title: AI Integration for Existing Businesses (Post-Ramon Framework)
doctrine.core_principle: Business converts attention to profit. AI is a tool like the internet was a tool. Do NOT become an AI business. Integrate AI invisibly into existing business functions.
strategic_rules: Fix the sales process BEFORE automating it. Automation amplifies dysfunction; broken process + AI = faster failure.
Own the full stack: strategy through API-plumbing. Selling only one layer (prompts, automation, strategy alone) is a commoditized trap.
Never advertise the tech to clients. Outcome is the product. The AI is the machinery behind the wall.
Pattern recognition is the real skill. AI surfaces patterns in data; the practitioner must interpret and act on them.
B2B requires proof (case studies, measurable ROI). B2C allows visual/aesthetic demonstration.
Niche targeting beats horizontal play. Non-tech local/regional businesses are the highest-leverage beachhead for AI systems integrators.
go_to_market: Cold email is the primary outbound lever for solopreneur AI operators. Leverage over labor.
Position as a systems builder, not an AI vendor. Frame deliverable as operational capacity, not tool delivery.
automation_patterns: Pre-check hash skips: before re-processing, hash-compare inputs to detect unchanged content and skip redundant runs.
No-agent deterministic stages: for predictable linear workflows, skip agent overhead and run deterministic scripts. Agents add value only where branching decisions are required.
context_from chaining: pass structured context objects between pipeline stages rather than re-querying state at each step.
Draft-mode account warmup: run accounts in draft/observe mode before activating outbound to avoid early flags.
Pinterest vs AI-gen routing: route image sourcing decisions by platform context (Pinterest for lifestyle/mood, AI-gen for product-absent or controlled-studio needs).
tool_notes: Postiz + Hermes cron chain: Postiz handles scheduling surface; Hermes provides the cron orchestration layer for multi-account pipelines.
Lovable/Gemini for SaaS scaffolding: low-code SaaS prototyping path for non-engineer founders.
CreateNodes for brand identity automation: batch generation of brand asset variants.
Hermes agent orchestration: multi-agent chaining with context_from and deterministic fallback stages.
doctrine.what_this_doc_is_not: Segments 11-19 are 95% YouTube tutorial walkthrough transcript (timestamps, UI nav, step-by-step explainers). No founding-principles doctrine, no market-dynamics analysis, no reusable decision frameworks. The operative content above is extracted from scattered thin bands across otherwise low-value instructional content.

notes: Part 1 (segs 1-10) carries all strategic weight. Part 2 (segs 11-19) is tutorial transcript with thin operative bands extracted above. De-duplicated: no repeated claims remain. Signal is LOW overall due to transcript bulk; extracted doctrine is usable but sparse relative to document length.
